_field_notes.role: host | sponsor | speaker | expert - drives speaker-page ordering and the expert label
_field_notes.country: Experts only. Renders as '[country] Expert' on the speaker page.
_field_notes.photo: Repo path, e.g. images/speakers/jaclynn-seah.jpg. Empty = initials avatar.
_field_notes.watch_url: Day-page watch button target. Empty until that day goes live.
_field_notes.source: airtable | manual - manual records are not in the Summit Speakers table
_field_notes.talk_titles: Array, generated from sessions.json. A speaker can present more than once (Jedd has a Day 2 and a Day 3 session), so this is never a single string. Destination experts show country instead of a title on speaker pages.
_field_notes.day: Not stored here. Day lives on the session in sessions.json.
